cues.text: The Moonlight Bridge, during the Dark Hour. A huge Shadow hangs in the arch of one of the bridge's towers, a figure dangling in the air. On the roadway below, Takaya, shirtless, his long hair down his back, stands looking up at it beside a young man in glasses holding a briefcase.
You and the others run up the roadway and stop a few metres behind them, taking up fighting stances. Takaya turns around to face you.
The young man with the briefcase squares up to fight.
